CassandraParameterColumnMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts a repository method argument or entity field value to a Cassandra statement parameter.
    If T is a custom scalar/column type, provide a CassandraParameterColumnMapper<T> component or annotate the parameter/field with @Mapping(...).
    If T is an entity value, check that the query parameter is expanded correctly and that mapper tags match the requested dependency.

CassandraRowColumnMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts one Cassandra row column to type T.
    If T is a custom scalar/column type, provide a CassandraRowColumnMapper<T> component or annotate the result field with @Mapping(...).
    If T is an entity result, request/provide CassandraRowMapper<T> instead and annotate the entity with @EntityCassandra when generation is expected.

CassandraRowMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts one Cassandra row to entity type T.
    If T is an entity, annotate it with @EntityCassandra so Kora can generate the row mapper.
    Alternative: provide a custom CassandraRowMapper<T> component or annotate the repository method/result with @Mapping(...). Check mapper tags if the dependency is tagged.

CassandraResultSetMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts a Cassandra ResultSet to repository method result type T.
    For entity results, Kora usually builds ResultSet mappers from CassandraRowMapper<Entity>; annotate the entity with @EntityCassandra or provide CassandraRowMapper<Entity>.
    For custom result shapes, provide a CassandraResultSetMapper<T> component or annotate the repository method with @Mapping(...).

CassandraAsyncResultSetMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts an async Cassandra ResultSet to repository method result type T.
    For entity results, Kora usually builds async result mappers from CassandraRowMapper<Entity>; annotate the entity with @EntityCassandra or provide CassandraRowMapper<Entity>.
    For custom async result shapes, provide a CassandraAsyncResultSetMapper<T> component or annotate the repository method with @Mapping(...).
